verdict.rationale: Box's developer docs explicitly reference official SDKs (llms.txt overview lists 'guides, API reference, SDKs, and tutorials') and a GitHub repo for the box-typescript-sdk-gen exists, but the only concrete SDK evidence includes a deprecation notice ('won't receive new features, updates, bug fixes, or security patches'), raising questions about SDK maintenance/version churn. Missing for 10: docs/examples for other language SDKs (Python, Java, .NET), no independent hands-on confirmation of SDK quality or AI-agent-specific usage patterns.
